detail.intro: Caliban is a premium Italian fashion brand known in particular for its high-quality shirts and timeless women’s fashion. The brand is synonymous with elegant cuts, high-quality fabrics, and sophisticated details.
detail.focus: The brand is especially popular for its blend of classic elegance and contemporary casual style—with a focus on quality, fit, and stylish everyday wear.

detail.intro:
Circolo 1901 is a premium Italian fashion brand founded in 2008 in Barletta, Apulia. The brand became known for its innovative “Easy Jacket”—a jacket made of soft sweatshirt jersey that combines Italian elegance with exceptional comfort.
Circolo 1901’s philosophy is “Easy but not simple”: timeless, high-quality fashion with a relaxed ease and a perfect fit.
detail.focus: Circolo 1901’s philosophy is “Easy but not simple”: timeless, high-quality fashion with a relaxed ease and a perfect fit.

detail.intro:
Daniele Fiesoli is a premium Italian fashion brand from Tuscany that specializes in high-quality knitwear and casual luxury for Women and Men. 
The brand combines traditional craftsmanship with modern design and is firmly committed to “Absolutely Made in Italy”—from the yarns to the finishing touches.
detail.focus: It is characterized by luxurious materials such as cashmere, merino wool, and mohair, minimalist cuts, and timeless, elegant looks with a focus on sustainability.

detail.intro:
Dea Kudibal is a Danish womenswear label based in Copenhagen that was founded in 2003 by designer Dea Kudibal. 
The brand is known for feminine, elegant, and timeless fashion featuring distinctive prints, often on high-quality stretch silk.
detail.focus: Dea Kudibal’s signature style combines Scandinavian minimalism with artistic influences and a deep passion for print design and fabric quality—which has helped the brand establish itself internationally.

detail.intro: DUNO is a modern Italian fashion brand that specializes in high-quality jackets and coats with a clean, contemporary aesthetic. The brand is known for combining functionality and design and caters to an urban, style-conscious clientele.
detail.focus: DUNO was founded in Italy in the 2010s with the goal of reimagining outerwear: minimalist in appearance, technically sophisticated in craftsmanship, and suitable for everyday wear in a variety of weather conditions.

detail.intro:
Since 2017, Edelle has stood for understated luxury that is natural, timeless, and elegant.
The brand is aimed at women who view fashion as an expression of minimalist and conscious style.
Particular attention is paid to selecting the finest materials, such as cotton, linen, silk, viscose, and cashmere.
detail.focus: Sustainability, quality, and precision craftsmanship define the brand’s philosophy. Production takes place primarily in European workshops, while the cashmere is sourced from Inner Mongolia.–

detail.intro:
FFC Fashion stands for modern women’s fashion with character and tradition. 
The brand combines contemporary design with high standards of quality, fit, and everyday wearability.
“Fashion with a history” captures the essence of the brand: collections that don’t just follow trends, but are rooted in a well-established brand identity and have been refined over the years. 
The result is fashion that is stylish, wearable, and timeless.
detail.focus:

The result is fashion that is stylish, wearable, and timeless.

detail.intro: Helmur is an Italian contemporary fashion brand that blends timeless elegance with modern craftsmanship. Built on the values of authenticity, quality, and refinement, the brand creates carefully curated women- and menswear  designed to transcend seasonal trends.
detail.focus: With a commitment to craftsmanship and conscious design, Helmur believes that true elegance is timeless—creating versatile pieces that become enduring staples in a modern wardrobe.

detail.intro:
IBELIV is a French-Malagasy brand specializing in handmade bags, hats, and accessories made from natural raffia.
The story began with a desire to combine traditional Madagascan craftsmanship with modern, timeless design. The founders work closely with local artisans to promote sustainable production, fair working conditions, and high-quality craftsmanship.
detail.focus: For Wearhouse, IBELIV expands the accessories offer with a label that feels warm, tactile, and rooted in craftsmanship. It provides contrast to more technical or fashion-driven brands while keeping the overall portfolio elevated.

detail.intro:
Mason’s is an Italian lifestyle and apparel Brand founded in Genoa in 1974. The brand specializes primarily in high-quality men’s and women’s pants.
Mason’s became known for combining Italian tailoring with a relaxed, timeless style.
detail.focus: Over the years, the brand has evolved and now offers complementary collections in addition to pants, while remaining true to its roots: Italian craftsmanship, modern fits, and an urban, casual-chic look.

detail.intro:
No Maps Society is developed and manufactured in Apulia, Italy—a region with a strong tradition of shoemaking, where craftsmanship and technical expertise are closely intertwined.
At its core is a clear balance between vision and execution, between market insight and artisanal precision.
detail.focus:
This results in a holistic system in which design, comfort, materials, and distribution are consistently aligned.
No Maps Society does not follow trends, but rather a clear purpose—defined by quality, clarity, and consistency.

detail.intro:
The Sassenbach fashion brand is known for modern, minimalist women’s fashion made in Germany. 
Its signature features include clean lines, timeless designs, and exceptional comfort thanks to high-quality Italian high-tech jersey.
detail.focus:
The collections combine elegance with a casual vibe and can be mixed and matched in countless ways.
At the same time, the brand places great emphasis on sustainability, fair production, and short supply chains.

detail.intro: Save the Duck is an Italian fashion brand that specializes in animal-free outdoor and casual clothing. The company does not use down, fur, or leather, opting instead for synthetic and recycled materials.
detail.focus: The brand is particularly well-known for its lightweight quilted jackets, which offer excellent thermal insulation and reflect a strong commitment to sustainability and environmental awareness.

detail.intro: SoSue is a modern fashion brand that focuses on trendy, feminine, and everyday women’s fashion. The brand combines elegant basics with eye-catching statement pieces and is aimed primarily at fashion-conscious women looking for a stylish, effortless look.
detail.focus: SoSue is particularly known for its high-quality fabrics, contemporary cuts, and a mix of casual chic and glamour.

detail.intro:
Tantä is a Spanish fashion brand from the Basque Country that specializes in stylish, waterproof rainwear. 
Founded in 2018, the brand combines functional outdoor elements with minimalist, modern designs and bold colors. 
Tantä is particularly known for its high-quality raincoats, jackets, and accessories made with 100% waterproof materials, sealed seams, and vegan fabrics.
detail.focus: The brand also follows a sustainable “slow fashion” approach with long-lasting products.

detail.intro:
The Jack Leathers is an Italian fashion brand that specializes in high-quality leather jackets, accessories, and urban-inspired outerwear. 
The brand combines traditional leather craftsmanship with modern design.
detail.focus: Its signature features include vintage effects, waxed and textured leather surfaces, and a distinctive, rock-inspired urban style.

detail.intro:
Tintoria Mattei 954 is a premium Italian men's fashion brand best known for its high-quality shirts.
The brand combines traditional Italian tailoring with modern, relaxed designs, distinctive prints, and high-quality fabrics.
detail.focus: . Its signature features include casual-chic cuts, vintage washes, and sophisticated details that blend smart casual and sartorial styles.

detail.intro: Velvet is a premium fashion brand founded in Los Angeles in 1997 that is known for timeless basics, high-quality materials, and a laid-back California style.
detail.focus: The label first gained recognition for its luxurious T-shirts and now offers women’s and men’s fashion characterized by minimalist elegance and exceptional comfort.

detail.intro:
Via Masini 80 is an Italian women’s fashion brand known in particular for its high-quality pants, modern cuts, and excellent fit.
The brand combines timeless elegance with trendy materials and consistently emphasizes “Made in Italy” craftsmanship.
detail.focus: Its style is aimed at modern, dynamic women who value comfort, quality, and sophisticated Italian fashion.
